extracted.name: Bananas Foster
extracted.description: Elegant bananas foster made with bananas cooked in a bubbling mixture of brown sugar, butter, rum, walnuts, and cinnamon, served over ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 3 bananas, peeled and sliced lengthwise and crosswise
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Stir in brown sugar, rum, vanilla, and cinnamon; bring to a low boil.
Place bananas and walnuts in the pan. Cook until bananas have softened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Serve at once over vanilla ice cream. Enjoy!
